title: Target Top Block Nondegenerate Splitting
body_html:
Target Top Block Nondegenerate Splitting

Let \(w\) be the vector supplied by supercuspidal_theta.occurrence_vector_choice, and write \(M(w)={}^bX+{}^aX\) with \({}^bX\in{}^b\Gamma+{}^b\mathbf g_{x,s}\). Define \[ {}^bV'=w({}^bV),\qquad {}^aV'=({}^bV')^\perp. \] Then \(w|_{{}^bV}:{}^bV\to{}^bV'\) is an isomorphism, \({}^bV'\) is nondegenerate, \(V'={}^bV'\oplus{}^aV'\), and \(w({}^aV)\subset{}^aV'\).
proof_html: Every element of \({}^b\Gamma+{}^b\mathbf g_{x,s}\) is invertible on the top block, so \(w^\ast w={}^bX\) makes \(w|_{{}^bV}\) injective and hence an isomorphism onto its image. The target form on \(w({}^bV)\) is computed by pairing through \(w^\ast w\), hence is nondegenerate. For \(v\in{}^aV\) and \(u\in{}^bV\), the pairing \(\langle wu,wv\rangle\) is \(\langle{}^bXu,v\rangle=0\), so \(w({}^aV)\subset{}^aV'\).
